classification.difficultyReason: Solve using inverse operations, reverse the inequality when dividing by a negative, and translate the result into the correct endpoint type and ray direction.

content.prompt: Solve each inequality and graph each solution on a number line.

spec.description: Open endpoint at 3 and a right-pointing solution ray. A ray is required; the supplied number-line template has no inequality-ray field.
Closed endpoint at 2 and a left-pointing solution ray. The number-line template cannot express inequality rays.
spec.mathematics: All real x less than or equal to 2.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}-5x&\ge20\\x&\le-4\end{align*}$$

Divide both sides by $-5$ and reverse the inequality sign.

spec.description: Closed endpoint at -4 and a left-pointing solution ray. The number-line template cannot express inequality rays.
spec.mathematics: All real x less than or equal to -4.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}-\frac{x}{2}&<4\\-x&<8\\x&>-8\end{align*}$$

Multiply both sides by $2$, then divide by $-1$ and reverse the inequality sign.

spec.description: Open endpoint at 8 and a left-pointing solution ray. The number-line template cannot express inequality rays.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}6-2x&<5\\-2x&<-1\\x&>\frac{1}{2}\end{align*}$$

Divide both sides by $-2$ and reverse the inequality sign.

spec.description: Open endpoint at one half, labelled fractional tick and a right-pointing solution ray. The number-line template cannot express inequality rays.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}7-3x&\ge5\\-3x&\ge-2\\x&\le\frac{2}{3}\end{align*}$$
